name: Muse Glimmer-30B (Meta)
purpose: Meta states: autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware: local agents, coding agents, tool calling, multimodal reasoning, synthetic data and LLM-as-judge; built to run locally without cloud access. Mixed purpose, primary pitch agentic.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file in the repo read: plain Apache License 2.0 (11,358 bytes, same md5 as the apache.org text). The card adds a usage policy (USAGE_POLICY.md, not opened) and says the model is not intended to be downloaded or used by persons under 18; these are intended-use statements outside the license text.

architecture.kind: dense transformer with local/global attention and ViT-G/14 perception encoder
architecture.attention: 3 local (sliding window 2048) : 1 global, GQA 32/2, gated attention
architecture.why_this_design: Card: built to run locally; distillation from Muse Spark; no further rationale given.

benchmarks.name: INCLUDE (German, PeerBench DACH)
benchmarks.harness: PeerBench DACH German Language LLM Index, run by PeerBench; no MMLU-ProX, GermEval, SB10K or ScaLA entry; the larger sibling Muse Spark Open leads the whole index (Elo 1866)

benchmarks.name: MuSR (German, PeerBench DACH)
benchmarks.harness: PeerBench DACH German Language LLM Index, run by PeerBench; no MMLU-ProX, GermEval, SB10K or ScaLA entry; the larger sibling Muse Spark Open leads the whole index (Elo 1866)

strengths: Best MCP-Atlas score in the 30B class (vendor)
Vision plus agent in one dense model; 17 GB quant fits 24 GB VRAM
weaknesses: Dense: 10.8 GB per pass limits decode on 16 GB cards (about 29 passes/s ceiling, research/08)
Lower Terminal-Bench than Qwen3.6-27B in Meta's own table (51.7 vs 60.7)
soft.behavior: Reasoning strength set in the system prompt (low to xhigh); T 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 64.
soft.maturity: Meta; about 203 quantized derivatives on the Hub.

user_reports.summary: Independent C++/CUDA port (NVFP4) runs it at about 53 tok/s on one RTX 5090 using 19.5 GB; the author lists four semantics that break naive ports: gated attention before the output projection, NoPE on the full-attention layers (pattern 3 sliding : 1 full), Gemma-2-style centered norms.

LoRA fine-tuning for llama.cpp serving cost a week of trial and error: labels must match the rendered assistant turn exactly, serving must use the same reasoning_strength as training (no "none" level), and a malformed header makes llama-server return 500 in reasoning mode.

tona_fit.reason: Dense 30B distilled from the leading Muse Spark, Apache-2.0 (text read), purpose-built for local agents with a claimed 17 GB quant for 24 GB cards; independent German scores are strong (INCLUDE DE 86.0, MuSR DE 86.1, on par with Qwen3.8-27B). No Tona backend yet (gated attention, NoPE full layers, centered norms) is only a blocker.
blockers: chat template and reasoning_strength handling in llama.cpp need care
